appropriate_uses: U.S. professional reporting on official deliberation, intelligence attribution, business/security context, and event chronology when article text is recoverable.
inappropriate_uses: Treating paywalled or snippet-only access as complete evidence; treating anonymous official accounts as direct proof of underlying events.
known_failure_modes: Paywall and excerpt access; anonymous official-source dependence; intelligence and business framing may compress uncertainty.
name: The Wall Street Journal
observables: reported official claims, intelligence attribution, security chronology, business and geopolitical reporting
originating_chain_rule: Treat each WSJ article as one chain unless separate original reporting and source access are documented; excerpts, search snippets, and syndications do not add independence.

review_history.note: Added for VER-20260813-01 Air Force One warning/deception packet; use is limited by available article text and anonymous official-source caveats.
